instructions: BOUNDARY item (part of a 60-item set built 2026-09-09 to check the arrest_legal / governor_political boundary specifically -- see START_HERE_2026-09-09.md for the full design). Read ONLY the Russian text below and answer ONE factual question -- do not apply any category scheme and do not think about what label the event should get. Question: does the text ITSELF state that a specific crime, criminal case, investigation, court action, or formal charge has been brought against a named person? 'Yes' requires the text to name or clearly describe such a thing -- a crime, an opened criminal/administrative case, a court decision or sentence, formal charges, or a finding by a prosecutor/oversight body -- directed AT a person. 'No' means the text describes only a resignation, dismissal, removal, term expiration, policy dispute, public statement, or similar political/personnel event, with nothing of that kind stated. 'Unclear' means the TEXT ITSELF is genuinely ambiguous on this specific factual question (not that you are torn between two category labels -- there is no category question here). Use Notes for anything worth flagging.
